description: job.get/list/cancel over the in-process job runtime: unknown ids, the empty and state-filtered and paged listings (items carry no result, T-109), the terminal progress shape, the finished-cancel no-op, the user write gate on job.cancel, the cli_cmd no-wait accept envelope and a cooperative cancel of a running import to the cancelled terminal state.

cases.name: job_get_unknown_id_not_found
cases.doc: job.get for an unknown job id returns not_found with no id echoed in the message

cases.name: job_list_empty
cases.doc: job.list on a process that ran no job returns an empty item list and a zero total

cases.name: job_list_state_filter
cases.doc: after one import succeeds, job.list state=succeeded returns that job (its summary carries no result, T-109) and state=failed is empty

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: job_list_pagination
cases.doc: three succeeded jobs page under limit/offset: page one returns two items, page two one item, and both report the same total of three

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: job_get_progress_shape
cases.doc: a terminal job.get carries the progress object with integer done/total counters and the command name

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: job_cancel_unknown_not_found
cases.doc: job.cancel for an unknown job id returns not_found

cases.name: job_cancel_finished_noop
cases.doc: cancelling an already-succeeded job is a no-op that returns its final succeeded state

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: job_cancel_requires_write
cases.doc: job.cancel is a write command; a read-only user is refused not_authorized before the job is even looked up

cases.name: job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion
cases.doc: the one-shot cmd CLI runs a job command to completion and prints the terminal job record (not the queued accept), even with options.async; this wait-for-completion mode is why cli_cmd skips the await cases

cases.name: job_cancel_running_import
cases.doc: a large import is cancelled cooperatively while running; the awaited terminal job is cancelled (job_cancelled) and a follow-up link.list shows a partial, bounded set of created rows

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion
